about: Canonical Zoom user id test vectors, shared by the zoomwarriors kernel (apps.authentication.journey_models.normalize_zoom_user_id) and the scopelybot plugin. Both sides must agree on every row. The kernel additionally treats as malformed any value its audit redaction would change (secret-shaped: a leaked token, a 32+ character letter-digit run); that rule is not part of this table. Rows with a 'wire' field are malformed in process (both implementations must say so) but an HTTP server may strip that whitespace before the kernel sees the header: see wire_reason.
rules: trim ASCII whitespace only (space, \t, \n, \r, \f, \v) at both ends; nothing else is trimmed (not NBSP, BOM, U+001C-U+001F, U+0085, U+2028, U+2029, U+3000: Python str.strip() and JS String.trim() each strip many non-ASCII spaces and disagree on some, so neither is used)
if the last 13 characters are ASCII and equal '@xmpp.zoom.us' ignoring ASCII case, drop them (once)
the rest must be ASCII; lower-case it
it must then fully match ^[a-z0-9_-]{6,64}$, else the value is malformed

classes.valid: canonical is the id to send / look up
classes.empty: nothing after trimming: the header is absent (kernel status missing)
classes.malformed: not a Zoom id (kernel status unmapped, detail: not a valid Zoom user id)
classes.multiple: contains ',': more than one value (kernel status ambiguous); checked before the shape
